name: Boom
description: A deep, punchy boom. The classic meme punch on a punchline.
use: Any punchline pop-in, exactly on the beat

name: Horror hit
description: Screeching strings and a low slam, like a jump scare.
use: Shocked reveals: "Photos: 118 GB 💀", the ex in the photo

name: Suspense rise
description: A dark drone that swells for 3 seconds, ending where the hit should land.
use: Start ~3 s before a horror hit or boom

name: Sad piano
description: A slow, lonely piano phrase in A minor.
use: Crying, "Storage Full" at the best moment, deleting the ex

name: Sad violin
description: One long, wobbly violin note that sinks at the end.
use: Defeated faces, "I give up", tiny violin moments

name: Smooth sax, getting louder
description: A sultry saxophone phrase that keeps getting louder.
use: Strut, side-eye, smug or "main character" moments

name: Fail trumpet
description: Wah, wah, wah, waaah: four sinking notes.
use: Picture fails, jump shots, "it's a plastic bag"

name: Record scratch
description: A needle scratch that stops everything.
use: "Wait, what?" moments; cut right before a reveal

name: Victory fanfare
description: A short brassy ta-da with a bell.
